intro.text: A Sho Del guide and boatwoman in Shadesmar.

items.text: MeLaan hired Jan Ven when she traveled through Shadesmar on Harmony's behalf. Jan Ven was sympathetic and accommodating, and explained much about how the Cognitive Realm works and about its cultures.

appearance.text: Like all Sho Del, she has four arms, reptilian eyes and chalk-white skin and hair.
